expo.name: FIXORA
expo.description: FIXORA is your AI home repair assistant. Take a photo or video of a broken appliance, faucet, car or furniture, describe the problem and get an instant step-by-step repair guide, safety warnings, cost estimate and local professional recommendations. Repair it yourself or find a nearby expert.
